title: Tangents to a Circle
summary: The tangent–radius theorem and equal tangents from an external point.
objectives: I can explain why a tangent is perpendicular to the radius.
I can prove that tangents from an external point are equal.
I can use these facts to find lengths and angles.
misconceptions: A tangent can cut a circle twice.
There can be three tangents from one point.
Tangents from a point have different lengths.
